summary.text: Jeremy LaCombe is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 18, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Iberville, Pointe Coupee, West Baton Rouge, and West Feliciana parishes. First elected in 2019, Jeremy LaCombe sits on the Judiciary, Natural Resources and Environment, and Ways and Means committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Jeremy LaCombe's occupation as attorney and small business owner, with a B.A. from Northwestern State University and a J.D. from the Louisiana State University Paul M. Hebert Law Center.

The House page lists Jeremy LaCombe's committee assignments as Judiciary, Natural Resources and Environment, Ways and Means, Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee, and Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Capital Region Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
